name: Top Bar
description: Custom menu bar with hover-activated dropdown menus (File/View/Tools/Help). File: Open Workspace, Exit. View: Terminal submenu (New + per-instance focus/reopen), Explorer, Git, Markdown, Canvas submenu (grid Dot/Grid/None), Zoom submenu (In/Out/Reset View/Lock). Tools: SpecsMap, Theme. Help: Tutorial, About. Plus a theme toggle button (◐) on the right, and a spacer. Menu opens on mouseenter (closes all other menus first), closes on mouseleave with 300ms timer (canceled by hover on dropdown). Click outside closes all. Dynamic terminal list items rendered from termItems prop. Supports GridStyle cycling and zoom lock display. Entire DOM re-renders on state changes (items, grid style, zoom lock). Uses theme.toggle() on button click.

interface.constructor: constructor(el: HTMLElement, callbacks: TopBarCallbacks) — Stores element reference and callbacks, initializes internal state (gridStyle='dots', zoomLocked=false, empty termItems/gitItems/specsmapItems arrays), calls render() to build full DOM

methods.name: setTerminalItems
methods.description: Updates internal termItems array and re-renders DOM

methods.name: setGitItems
methods.description: Updates internal gitItems array and re-renders DOM

methods.name: setSpecsmapItems
methods.description: Updates internal specsmapItems array and re-renders DOM

methods.name: setGridStyle
methods.description: Updates internal gridStyle state and re-renders DOM

methods.name: setZoomLocked
